name: scale-letter-text
title: Scale Letter Text
description: A pointer hops across the word letter by letter: the hovered letter swells, lifts toward the viewer and tilts back, its neighbours follow at half strength, all with a springy overshoot.
useWhen: A title should feel tactile, as if a cursor were pressing each letter forward in turn.
A short bold word with room around it.
avoidWhen: A quiet, one-direction entrance: use per-character-rise.
Long sentences: the pointer visits each letter in turn.
author: Eldora UI

variables.label: Time per letter
variables.description: Seconds the pointer rests on each letter (at least the 0.4s transition).

variables.label: Pointer enters
variables.description: Seconds before the pointer reaches the first letter.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Text size in pixels. The source is built for 72px type; its pixel offsets scale with this size.
